[[File:Zachary Hoenn.png|thumb|250px|Zachary]] '''Zachary''' (Japanese: '''ゼカー''' ''Zeker'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|AG}} who appeared in ''[[AG084|Who's Flying Now?]]'' and ''[[AG085|A Sky High Gym Battle!]]''. He lives in [[Fortree City]] and is employed as the [[Gym]] assistant at the [[Fortree Gym]]. Among his responsibilities are [[Battle judge|refereeing]] Gym battles between [[Winona]] and her opponents, as well as maintaining and watching the Gym while she is away. When {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrived at the Fortree Gym, Zachary was there to greet them. He informed them that Winona was at the [[Feather Carnival]] and could not battle at that moment. Zachary refereed the match between Ash and Winona in the [[AG085|following episode]]. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{flying color light}} |ja=山口隆行 ''Takayuki Yamaguchi'' |en=[[Darren Dunstan]] |fi=Joonas Suominen |fr_eu=Antoni Lo Presti |es_eu=Eduardo del Hoyo}}
